tracklist: You Never Wash Up After Yourself

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (8 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/182449-Radiohead-My-Iron-Lung, https://idioteque.fandom.com/wiki/My_Iron_Lung_(EP). Third EP (Oct 1994). This is the 8-track EP edition (US/EU CD); the UK also issued it as two 4-track CD singles. 'Creep (Acoustic)' is the same KROQ recording that closes the Itch EP.
